expected.raw_text: Experience building agentic AI solutions for pricing is highly desirable.

parsed.degree_signal: PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Operational Research, or a related STEM field with 6+ years of relevant experience, or MS with 8+ years experiences with equivalent publications.
parsed.notes:
The qualifications section defaults to required; 'highly desirable' explicitly makes agentic AI experience optional.
Excluded techniques mentioned only in responsibilities or the role description, including double ML, switchback testing, constrained optimization, mixed-integer programming, and stochastic optimization.
Read 'machine learning modeling' as machine learning, without adding a separate model-development criterion; distributed processing does not itself ask for distributed-systems expertise.
Workflow orchestration is not LLM orchestration; AWS data storage does not identify S3 or object storage.
The degree label uses the highest level named. The MS alternative and equivalent publications do not waive the degree in favor of experience.
No alternative skill groups are present; the listed techniques and tools are requested together.
